text_block_list.text:
After the Selection Race.
I'd only seen Duramente for a short while,
but——
her running definitely seemed different from
before.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaa…… Kuu…… Fuu……!

Did something happen after the Selection
Race? 
Maybe I was overthinking it, but still——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Huu. ……Haa……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: Is it hard to talk about……?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……No. I have a request.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Are you able to dance?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Without raising your shoulders——
lift your elbows. 
Yes……that's the basic form.

And so, now, Duramente was teaching me 
how to be a proper escort to a dance
party.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
For accepting my invitation, I'm grateful.

……But,
I was surprised when she first made that
request. 
Since a "Dance" didn't really have anything
to do with races.
choice_data_list: Attending a party is tough, huh?
Attending a party is tough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……It isn't tough.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's something I must do.
My mother and grandmother both performed 
their roles admirably,
neither missing a single step. Further……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Have you ever seen my father or
grandfather?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just by stepping in,
they lit a fire. People in the stadium 
could feel it.
The glory that their participation would
bring.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
They cried out. With a thunderous voice,
one that crossed borders, 
it gave people hope.
That 『Only he can stand at the top』

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And it wasn't just them.
Those that the people 
praise as the "Strongest" all posses
speed, stamina,
and mental strength. More than that——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——Perfect, and the strongest.

At that moment, she took my hand and 
raised it up, then she twirled twice——

She danced——as if she was born to do it. 
Elegantly,
almost frighteningly……"Perfect".
And then, the day of the dance party.

At the party were several influential families,
like the Symboli and Mejiro families,
as well as others. Many Uma 
Musume representing the racing world were
present.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee
text_block_list.text:
This year's dance time is also quite lovely.
Active racers 
like Satono Crown-san and……Fufuu,
Duramente-san too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Your hand.

Her dancing would probably be perfect.
Under the watchful 
gaze of the crowd,
I offered my hand to Duramente——

——I could tell that Duramente's 
hand was cold and trembling.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
——！ ——……Pardon me. Wait. 
——…………

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……No. 
I'm——

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
That family's achievements are numerous.
When 
you look anywhere in the sports world,
you see their "Face"…… And that girl,
will be one too.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Right. Finally,
it's the "Race World's" turn! 
The culmination of that family,
this time they 
will change the history of the racing
world……!

Duramente's trembling became more
noticeable. 
Her trembling reminded me of the "disbelief"
I felt before.

——How during the Selection Race, 
she was unable to demonstrate her full
potential.

At that time,
expectations on her were high to produce
results. 
As a "Daughter from that family" her victory
was expected.

She always had to endure that kind of
pressure——

——That's right,
there was no way she wasn't. Even 
right now,
she had the full attention of the racing 
world and countless expectations placed upon
her.

……But even then,
she still didn't ask for help. 
She was trying to cover it up by putting on
a 『Brave Face』——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——Perfect, and the strongest.
choice_data_list: (She thinks she has to be like that?)
(She thinks she has to be like that?)

text_block_list.text:
Just like the people she respects,
she thinks she has to put on the 
air of perfection.
……Thinking she can't show any of her
imperfections.

Maybe she had been pushing herself so
hard, 
thinking she couldn't show any signs
nervousness.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……——No problem. 
I am……!
——I spoke before she could say anymore.

I desperately tried to find the words to
say. 
If she kept pushing herself stubbornly like
this——

I'll try starting with how we're the
"Same"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Dura? 
Are you feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! Father——
choice_data_list: Sorry, I was just feeling nervous!
Sorry, I was just feeling nervous!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text: ……? You're——

The person standing before me was the very
symbol of "Perfection" 
that Duramente was aiming for.
Then……let's try asking him.
choice_data_list: But everyone's nervous at first, r...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……!? You,
who do you think you're saying that——

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
……Yes. When I was younger, all the time. 
My knees were always shaking.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——! Father……?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dura and……you too.
Can I have a moment of your time? 
……There's something I want to show you.
